name: zc_water_reflect

tests.name: this engine offers a refraction mode that is not NONE

detail.note: ENUMERATED RATHER THAN GUESSED. The previous attempt tried three hoped-for spellings inside a try/except and left the material at RM_NONE when none matched, reporting nothing. A guarded guess that silently does nothing is worse than no attempt.

tests.name: the water is now allowed to reflect, read back off the asset

detail.note: THE READBACK IS THE RESULT. Setting a property and saving is not evidence it took, and four conclusions this week were withdrawn for exactly that mistake.

tests.name: the water now refracts, read back off the asset
the settings that were already right were left alone

detail.note: the translucency lighting mode was already the per-pixel surface one and the blend mode was already translucent. A fix that quietly rewrites the parts that were working is how a narrow change becomes an unreviewable one.
